# `aitbc economics status`

Show the status of an OpenClaw DAO economic parameter proposal by proposal ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc economics status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal-id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc economics status --proposal-id <proposal_id>
```
